notes: Each house has seven cards. 'strength' is the printed combat strength.
'swords' is the number of sword icons (extra casualties inflicted on a win).
'forts' is the number of fortification icons (cancels incoming casualties).
'ability' is a machine-readable id for the card's special effect. 'none' means
the card is fully modelled by its printed stats alone.
Names, strengths, icons and ability text are transcribed from the user-supplied
House Martell is included in the reference sheet and is now marked verified;
the previous file was missing Darkstar and had the Martell strengths wrong.
Ability ids map to handlers in rust/crates/agot-core/src/house_cards.rs.
on a player sub-choice (which unit, which order, which card) expose that
sub-choice as a real action in Python training/evaluation and desktop play;
only the low-level fixture/test battle helpers keep deterministic defaults.

cards.name: Patchface
cards.text: After combat, you may look at your opponent's hand and discard one card of your choice.

cards.name: Salladhor Saan
cards.text: If you are being supported in this combat, the combat strength of all non-Baratheon Ships is reduced to 0.

cards.name: Ser Davos Seaworth
cards.text: If "Stannis Baratheon" is in your discard pile, this card gains +1 combat strength and a sword icon.

cards.name: Renly Baratheon
cards.text: If you win this combat, you may upgrade one of your participating Footmen (or one supporting Baratheon Footman) to a Knight.

cards.name: Stannis Baratheon
cards.text: If your opponent has a higher position on the Iron Throne Influence track than you, this card gains +1 combat strength.

cards.name: Cersei Lannister
cards.text: If you win this combat, you may remove one of your opponent's Order tokens from anywhere on the board.

cards.name: Tyrion Lannister
cards.text: You may immediately return your opponent's House card to his hand. He must then choose a different House card. If he has no other House cards in hand, he cannot use a House card this combat.

cards.name: Ser Kevan Lannister
cards.text: If you are attacking, all of your participating Footmen (including supporting Lannister Footmen) add +2 combat strength instead of +1.

cards.name: Tywin Lannister
cards.text: If you win this combat, gain two Power tokens.

cards.name: Catelyn Stark
cards.text: If you have a Defence Order token in the embattled area, its value is doubled.

cards.name: The Blackfish
cards.text: You do not take casualties in this combat from House card abilities, Combat icons, or Tides of Battle cards.

cards.name: Roose Bolton
cards.text: If you lose this combat, return your entire House card discard pile into your hand (including this card).

cards.name: Robb Stark
cards.text: If you win this combat, you may choose the area to which your opponent retreats. You must choose a legal area where your opponent loses the fewest units.

cards.name: Aeron Damphair
cards.text: You may immediately discard two Power tokens to discard Aeron Damphair and choose a different House card from your hand (if able).

cards.name: Asha Greyjoy
cards.text: If you are not being supported in this combat, this card gains two sword icons and one fortification icon.

cards.name: Theon Greyjoy
cards.text: If you are defending an area that contains either a Stronghold or a Castle, this card gains +1 combat strength and a sword icon.

cards.name: Balon Greyjoy
cards.text: The printed combat strength of your opponent's House card is reduced to 0.

cards.name: Victarion Greyjoy
cards.text: If you are attacking, all of your participating Ships (including supporting Greyjoy Ships) add +2 combat strength instead of +1.

cards.name: Queen of Thorns
cards.text: Immediately remove one of your opponent's Order tokens in any area adjacent to the embattled area other than the March Order token used to start this combat.

cards.name: Ser Loras Tyrell
cards.text: If you are attacking and win this combat, move the March Order token used into the conquered area to resolve again later this round.

cards.name: Mace Tyrell
cards.text: Immediately destroy one of your opponent's attacking or defending Footmen units.

cards.name: Nymeria Sand
cards.text: If you are defending, this card gains a fortification icon. If you are attacking, this card gains a sword icon.

cards.name: Arianne Martell
cards.text: If you are defending and lose this combat, your opponent may not move his units into the embattled area. They return to the area from which they marched. Your own units must still retreat.

cards.name: Doran Martell
cards.text: Immediately move your opponent to the bottom of one Influence track of your choice.
